A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 17-page versions of the same Δ-LFM paper, including Appendices A–I. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 3–17 are identical; the differences are confined to the opening pages.

before.justification: v3 reports original longitudinal MRI generation experiments on ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS-3, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, prediction-horizon results, and robustness analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, prediction-horizon evaluations, and robustness analyses reported in v3, including Tables 1–7 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: The ArcRank objective, SVD decomposition, ranking and pull terms, temporal flow matching, conditioning, and inference procedures in Section 3 and Appendix B are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS-3 for longitudinal Alzheimer’s disease MRI generation. Prediction-horizon coverage and perturbed-conditioning scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same eight baselines: CardiacAging, CounterSynth, DiffuseMorph, SADM, TADM, ImageFlowNet, BrLP, and MambaControl. Comparator membership in the ablations and qualitative comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The preprocessing, 80/5/15 train/validation/test split, evaluation metrics, training budgets, model configurations, and appendix testing procedures are identical.

E4.justification: Both retain the component and autoencoder ablations, latent-space visualization, loss-weight and speed analyses, residual-noise sensitivity study, and clinical-conditioning robustness tests. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, the noise-analysis statistics in Table 7, and the 50-run timing measurement remain unchanged. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7, qualitative figures, and numerical results in the prose are identical. For example, both report ADNI PSNR of 30.59±0.89 and Δ-RMAE of 0.436±0.08 for Δ-LFM.

T1.justification: Equations 1–20, the latent-trajectory assumptions, loss definitions, flow-matching formulation, and Δ-RMAE perturbation reasoning are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific claims about patient-specific trajectories, arbitrary-time prediction, ArcRank, Δ-RMAE, and empirical performance. The new code-access sentence does not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, interpretations of benchmark and ablation results, long-horizon qualifications, and limitations concerning disease coverage and dataset heterogeneity are unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 adds a 'Code available' statement and the GitHub repository address chqwer2/Delta-LDM-Longitudinal to the abstract; v3 provides no corresponding code-access information. Implementation settings remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish the repository’s contents or usability.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to prior progression models are unchanged. The added implementation link is not a new research citation.

P1.justification: v4 adds the code-access sentence, marks Chao Li as corresponding author, and changes the existing email footnote from 'Correspondence to' to 'Contact.' Scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added abstract sentence and author footnote cause limited text reflow on pages 1–2, including moving an introduction line onto page 2. Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–7 retain identical displays and placement.

improvement.justification: The newly documented code repository provides an explicit route to locating the implementation, a limited improvement in reproducibility documentation. Scientific content, experimental evidence, and limitations are unchanged. The supplied PDFs cannot verify repository contents or usability, so they do not support a stronger reproducibility gain.
